title: Prismatic
description: Terrain, visual, and sound overhaul that makes Minecraft feel exciting again while staying mostly vanilla.
body:
### Not for low end hardware!
---

Server side version will have full compatibility with the client version. Alternativly, you can host with from the client and all features will still work.

Prismatic is a Fabric modpack built around making Minecraft look, sound, and play in a way that makes it exciting again.

Terralith, Tectonic, Incendium, and Nullscape overhaul terrain across all 
three dimensions. Dungeons and Taverns adds strucutres. Voxy pushes your view distance way out. Eclipse shader ties it all together visually. Everything is vanilla blocks with animated and upgraded visuals.

I've done my best to optimize but visuals come first. Disable shaders if your game is stuttering. I would recommend giving Minecraft 6+ Gbs of RAM for this one.

Waystones are included for fast travel, and a handful of extra enchantments 
round things out.

Eclipse Shader (not bundled) — install it separately:
[shader download](https://github.com/Merlin1809/Eclipse-Shader)
The config is included, so it'll work out of the box once you drop it in your 
shaderpacks folder.

### Don't use this for worlds you care a lot about
I can't promise this won't break at some point. Especially when updating between versions. Once you make a world in one version of this pack do not move it to another version. Things have a high chance of breaking. Back up your worlds often like any sane person would.

You can contact me at contact.cooler.attribute586@aleeas.com
